g.title: OrderServiceArchitecture
g.text: Order Service architecture | implemented component view (C4 level 3)

g.title: supplier
g.text: supplier HTTP API; deactivation fact publisher

g.title: credit->credit_x
g.text: AMQP publish: release, amend, transfer results

g.title: http_adapters->credit
g.text: reserve on creation; release on DB failure

g.title: timed->repos
g.text: locks due orders; writes status + facts

g.title: supplier_listener->repos
g.text: locks matching orders; writes inbox + facts

g.title: db
g.text: orders; order_requests; release, update, approval tasks;

g.title: relay->order_x
g.text: AMQP publish; routing key = event type

g.title: legend
g.text: Blue/green solid arrow = synchronous call or local control
Orange dashed arrow = AMQP event flow (publisher to broker to consumer)
Green outline = Order Service boundary; cylinder = its own data store
